target.statement: SPINE attains the highest mean accuracy (0.9110) across 17 benchmark datasets at matched budget under stratified 10-fold CV
target.dataset: 17 KEEL/benchmark datasets (e.g., Iris, Wine, ... up to Letter, 20,000 obs)

compute.basis: The only linked repo is the GNG baseline, not SPINE; reproducing the headline mean accuracy requires reimplementing the full 5-phase SPINE method plus 7 baselines and running 10-fold CV over 17 datasets (up to 20k points), which is many CPU-hours of custom code.

blockers: SPINE implementation not released (only GNG baseline repo linked)
must reimplement 7 baselines (RSP3, SPOT, LVQ3, GLVQ, GNG, KMeans, Random) and the full multi-phase method
17 datasets x 10 folds x 8 methods is a large experimental campaign
